title: spec-ambiguity: fix_signal Phase 3 patch instruction assumes picked_up_at and fix_branch absent but schema pre-populates them as null
description: Phase 3 instructs the agent to patch the closing } to insert picked_up_at and fix_branch fields. The canonical signal schema already includes these fields initialised to null, so patching the closing } would produce duplicate keys. The agent improvised by using write_file with the complete updated content instead. The skill instruction needs to account for the null-initialised field layout.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 to instruct patch_file targeting the existing null field values: old_string '"picked_up_at": null' -> new_string with ISO timestamp, and '"fix_branch": null' -> new_string with branch name.
